newsitem.title: USA: AMLI Residential sells 1.5 million shares.
newsitem.headline: AMLI Residential sells 1.5 million shares.

text.p: AMLI Residential Properties Trust said Wednesday it has completed the sale of 1.5 million shares for $23.4375 a share.

The real estate investment trust said it plans to use net proceeds from the offering of about $33.2 million principally to pay down balances outstanding under AMLI's $100 million unsecured line of credit and to fund future acquisition and development activities.

Following completion of the offering, AMLI's common shares outstanding totalled 16.4 million, or 20.5 million including convertible preferred shares and operating partnership units, and AMLI's debt to market capitalization ratio has been reduced to 35 percent, the apartment company said.
AMLI shares closed down 1/16 at 23-3/8 Wednesday.
